review_style.value: One fresh-eyes review pass per change

also.quote: Great, now I want you to carefully read over all of the new code you just wrote and other existing code you just modified with "fresh eyes," looking super carefully for any obvious bugs, errors, problems, issues, confusion, etc. Use a subagent.
I have been using this for doing all sorts of things for months (entity extract my emails, do aggressive code reviews, run agents, etc) and I was very happy with the results.

rules_files.quote: One policy governs every coding agent on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, whatever comes next). Each tool reads its own real file — no imports between them, no symlinks, no generation step.

signature.caption: a subagent rereads the code
